answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents anchor identity proofs to a docking wharf via cryptographic attestation chains. Sybil swarms face a multi-agent staking gate that refracts incoming verification across a prism of interdependent consensus bonds, driving exponential capital exhaustion where attacking costs scale superlinearly as $O(k^3)$ against swarm size $k$.
